TITLE: 01 — Relief
SUB: The lock as one soft white relief, lit from the left. Water is the only colour.
RULE: Hold the gate. Let the ball fall.
S_READY: White model at rest, ball above the water. Black pill: “Drop the ball”.
S_HELD: The held plate turns water-blue; a pill counts down the 0.9 s.
S_JAM: Ball rests on a plate in its shadow. Attempt +1, “Drop again”.
S_LOAD: “Filling the canal…”: water rises inside the white relief.
